text:
maria_support: FYI customer 'BetterDocs' reported a sudden p99 spike after we onboarded sIrocco-x v1.2 earlier today. p95 ~ 210ms (stable) but p99 jumped from 420ms -> 1.9s in the 10:20-10:40 window. Can we triage?

jon_oncall: got it. any sample request IDs or a quick repro payload? did they use long-multilang inputs? @rahul_runtime can you check runtime queues and kv-cache miss rate?

maria_support: Request IDs: req_0a9f, req_0b3e, req_0c55. Customer says spike happens on chat completions when prompts include emoji + CJK + code blocks. Example payload I used to repro:```json
{
  "model": "sirocco-x:1.2",
  "input": "你好 👋
```js
console.log(\"hi\")
```
 repeated... (long)"
}
```
Rolling them back to 1.1 temporarily cut p99 back to ~480ms.

rahul_runtime: quick summary from runtime side: after profiling the captured reqs, token counts for those inputs jumped 2.3x with v1.2 compared to v1.1. Tokenization appears to split emoji and some CJK sequences into many more subtokens due to the new merge table. That increases sequence length, which hits slowpath kernel dims and forces more KV sharding + cache misses. I can repro locally with this curl:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/complete -H 'Authorization: Bearer X' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"sirocco-x:1.2","input":"你好 👋 hello 😊 repeated..."}' | jq '.'
```

rahul_runtime: also attaching small snapshot of runtime log (trimmed):
```
[10:22:11] req_0a9f start seq_len=512 -> actual_tokens=1184 latency=1850ms kv_cache_miss=0.78
[10:22:12] req_0b3e start seq_len=480 -> actual_tokens=1100 latency=1922ms kv_cache_miss=0.81
[10:22:13] req_0c55 start seq_len=128 -> actual_tokens=420 latency=460ms kv_cache_miss=0.12
```

sasha_ml: this matches a tokenizer change in the new merge table we applied to sIrocco-x:1.2 (we updated byte-pair merges to better handle rare scripts, but it seems we over-split emoji + CJK combos). Suggestions: 1) rollback tokenizer merges for the canary 2) enable aggressive prefix KV caching for affected routes 3) add a tokenizer preflight that rejects pathological token expansion (temporary mitigation).

jon_oncall: pragmatic ops steps: - route BetterDocs to sIrocco-x:1.1 right away; - enable prefix KV caching for their tenant; - increase autoscale burst +20% for the pool serving sIrocco; - mark the v1.2 canary paused. Can someone kick off the route change and rollback?

maria_support: I've requested the route change and customer CS confirmed they accept rollback. Starting route switch now.

deploy-bot: Automated: route-update initiated for tenant=betterdocs target_model=sirocco-x:1.1 by maria_support at 2026-03-17T10:28:14Z

maria_support: also set temporary policy: prefix_kv_cache=on for tenant betterdocs.

rahul_runtime: confirmed kv-caching toggle applied. watching metrics. initial telemetry shows p99 trending down (currently 590ms).

jon_oncall: monitoring query to watch (Grafana/Prometheus):
```
sum(rate(request_duration_ms_bucket{model=~"sirocco-x:.*",tenant="betterdocs"}[5m])) by (le)
```

elena_cs: customer is pleased with rollback for now. We'll schedule a postmortem with ML and runtime to decide whether to change merges or add a preflight tokenizer validation.

sasha_ml: I'll prepare a diff for the merge table and a small tokenizer testset that includes emoji+CJK+code combos so we catch this in future canaries.

jon_oncall: thanks all — keep this thread updated if p99 climbs again.

maria_support: will update postmortem link and add sample failing tokens. End of thread for now. :white_check_mark:
